channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Lewis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Lewis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on John Lewis
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:More from Pop on John Lewis:

“He tried to make this nation live up to its promises... He was always hopeful, always ready for the fight in a good way. He pushed America, pushed white privilege.”

Gregg Popovich on John Lewis, Jul 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Doc Rivers on John Lewis
item.description:
Rivers said before practice Saturday.

“What is amazing is when you think of right now, some of the stuff that John Lewis was fighting for, we're still fighting for. Voter suppression right now is at an all-time high.”

Doc Rivers on John Lewis, Jul 18, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on John Lewis
item.description:
“John Lewis' stature in the Civil Rights Movement was gigantic and the example he set for people like myself will endure,”

Kareem Abdul-Jabbar on John Lewis, Jul 18, 2020. Source: ESPN.
